description: This file defines the AppDelegate class for a macOS Flutter application, implementing app lifecycle behaviors such as termination and support for secure state restoration.

classes.name: AppDelegate
classes.description: A subclass of FlutterAppDelegate that manages application lifecycle events for a macOS Flutter app.

methods.name: applicationShouldTerminateAfterLastWindowClosed(_:)
methods.description: Returns true to indicate the application should terminate when the last window is closed.

methods.name: applicationSupportsSecureRestorableState(_:)
methods.description: Returns true to support secure state restoration for the application.
